top_choice_rationale: Structure-directed design of molecular-sieve catalysts (Zones, Davis, Corma) is a decades-mature, widely deployed achievement with crystallographically verified structure-to-function links and a clean three-person allocation; after it I prefer the degrader and base-editing proposals, whose concepts are independently reproduced, over C-N coupling or condensates, and no award last.
recusal_note: P003 (zeolite design) lies in my own research field of zeolite and porous-material structure determination by electron crystallography; no specific personal tie to the named laureates is apparent from the profile.
